lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are positioned posterior to the gills. The central rows exhibit larger, more regularly spaced centroids compared to the smaller, more densely packed clusters immediately adjacent to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with circular blobs frequently situated at the intersection points of these vertical bands and the horizontal rows, creating a defined grid-like arrangement across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal side transitioning to a darker shadow-like boundary on the ventral side.
